games.title: Prism Ridge Rally
games.tagline: Clip every gate on a luminous mountain circuit.
games.description: A compact third-person time trial with momentum, off-track slowdown, ordered checkpoints, and two fast laps.
games.instructions: Drive with WASD or the arrow keys. Steer through each glowing gate in order. On touch screens, use the directional controls.

games.title: Fernlight Expedition
games.tagline: Gather the glowcaps hidden across a tiny wild island.
games.description: A relaxed 3D collection expedition through trees, rocks, flowers, and winding meadow paths.
games.instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys and walk into all eight glowcaps before sunset. Touch players can use the directional pad.
games.assetPack: Kenney Nature Kit and Platformer Kit (CC0)

games.title: Cloudstep Courier
games.tagline: Leap the floating route and deliver every sky coin.
games.description: A responsive 3D platform run with rising islands, collectible coins, fall recovery, and a finish flag.
games.instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys and jump with Space or the action button. Collect six coins, then reach the flag.

games.title: Orbit Needle
games.tagline: Thread a racer through a collapsing meteor lane.
games.description: A 3D survival flight where you slide in every direction, graze meteors, and protect a three-hit hull.
games.instructions: Fly with WASD or the arrow keys. You can also drag on the flight deck. Survive the meteor stream until extraction.

games.title: Starforge Range
games.tagline: Track moving targets across a zero-gravity range.
games.description: A precision 3D target gallery with moving alien drones, limited time, pointer aim, and keyboard crosshair control.
games.instructions: Aim and click or tap a target to fire. Keyboard players move the crosshair with the arrows and fire with Space.

games.title: Mossvault Maze
games.tagline: Find three crystals and unlock the forest gate.
games.description: A readable top-down 3D maze escape with hidden crystals, solid wall collision, and a final locked exit.
games.instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Collect all three crystals, then reach the mint exit before time runs out.
games.assetPack: Kenney Nature Kit, Platformer Kit, and Tower Defense Kit (CC0)

games.title: Comet Goal 3D
games.tagline: Curve three shots through the orbital goal.
games.description: A compact 3D football challenge with dribbling, charged kicks, goal resets, and a moving keeper block.
games.instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Press Space or the action button near the ball to kick toward the goal.

games.title: Bastion Bloom
games.tagline: Plant crystal turrets and hold the center.
games.description: A 3D defense survival game with enemy waves, resource-driven turret placement, automatic targeting, and core health.
games.instructions: Click or tap the field to place a turret for 25 energy. Keyboard players move the placement marker and press Space. Survive every wave.

games.title: Skycrate Stack
games.tagline: Drop, trim, and balance a tower above the clouds.
games.description: A physics-like 3D stacking challenge where every imperfect drop trims the next platform and raises the risk.
games.instructions: Click, tap, or press Space to drop the moving crate. Keep enough overlap to build a twelve-crate tower.

games.title: Harbor Dash Delivery
games.tagline: Collect cargo and race it to three bright docks.
games.description: A timed 3D driving route with pickup and drop-off zones, barrier collisions, route changes, and a ticking delivery clock.
games.instructions: Drive with WASD or the arrow keys. Enter the gold pickup ring, then follow the mint beacon to deliver three crates.
games.assetPack: Kenney Racing Kit and Platformer Kit (CC0)
